title: Understand roles, capabilities and location access
summary: Give people the tools they need without confusing professional titles with permissions.

sections.title: Three independent settings
sections.body: A **Professional title** describes a person, such as stylist or receptionist. Their **Workspace role** determines login capabilities. **Locations they can access** limits where those capabilities apply. Their working branches, services and hours are managed separately.

sections.title: Review or change access
sections.body:
1. Open **Team & availability → Access**, or open the person’s profile and choose **Access**.
2. Review their current role and locations.
3. Choose an available **Workspace role**, or select **Customize capabilities** for an exact set of responsibilities.
4. Review each selected capability, especially client contact details, sensitive notes, exports, refunds, revenue, team management and billing.
5. Choose **Locations they can access** and select **Save access**. Add a reason when useful.

sections.title: Access safeguards
sections.body: You cannot grant capabilities you are not allowed to manage. Only owners can change another owner’s access. Manage your own security in **Profile & security** rather than changing your own workspace role here. A branch manager’s authority stays within their assigned scope. A person with own-calendar access may see only their linked working profile.

sections.title: Why a page or record is missing
sections.body: Check the signed-in email, business, role, accessible locations and the business’s subscription features. Client details, financial information and private records can have separate restrictions even when a page is visible. Ask an owner to review the specific responsibility instead of broadly enabling every capability.

screenshots.caption: Working profiles and permission to sign in are managed separately.
